channel.label: Channel
channel.missingProfile: No profile is linked for this channel. You can paste the profile text below.

states.idle: No pitch yet. Read the profile and write the icebreaker.

paste.title: Paste profile text
paste.description: Copy the bio and one or two posts from the profile in here. It produces the same icebreaker as the bridge.
paste.tooShort: That is not enough yet. Add the bio or a post.

errors.BRIDGE_NOT_CONFIGURED: No extension ID is set. Add NEXT_PUBLIC_PROFILE_BRIDGE_EXTENSION_ID to .env.local and restart the dev server.
errors.BRIDGE_MISSING: The profile bridge is not responding. Check that the extension is installed and enabled, and that you opened the workspace on localhost:3001.
errors.NOT_LOGGED_IN: Instagram is not signed in on this browser. Sign in and try again.
errors.PROFILE_NOT_FOUND: The profile was not reachable. Check the linked profile URL.
errors.PROFILE_PRIVATE: The profile is private. Paste the visible profile text manually.
errors.TAB_NOT_OPEN: Open the LinkedIn profile in a tab, then the bridge can read it.
errors.RATE_LIMITED: Instagram is throttling right now. Wait a moment and try again.
errors.TIMEOUT: The bridge took too long. Try again.
errors.BRIDGE_NETWORK_ERROR: The bridge could not reach Instagram. Check your connection and try again.
errors.BRIDGE_UPSTREAM_UNAVAILABLE: Instagram is temporarily unavailable. Wait a moment and try again.
errors.BRIDGE_INVALID_RESPONSE: Instagram returned an unexpected response. Reload the extension and try again.
errors.BRIDGE_INTERNAL: The profile bridge failed internally. Reload the extension and try again.
errors.NO_PROFILE_DATA: The profile holds too little for a real icebreaker. Paste the profile text manually.
errors.ICEBREAKER_TOO_LONG: The icebreaker does not fit the character limit. Try again.
errors.PROVIDER_AUTHENTICATION_FAILED: OpenAI rejected the credentials. Check the API key.
errors.PROVIDER_MODEL_UNAVAILABLE: The configured AI model is unavailable. Check OPENAI_MODEL.
errors.PROVIDER_RATE_LIMITED: The AI rate limit has been reached. Wait a moment and try again.
errors.PROVIDER_REJECTED: OpenAI rejected the request. Check the model configuration.
errors.PROVIDER_INVALID_RESPONSE: OpenAI returned an unusable response. Try again.
errors.PROVIDER_UNAVAILABLE: The AI model is not reachable right now.
errors.PITCH_INTERNAL: The pitch could not be created on the server.
